# Dependency-Ordered Work

Build a mental DAG of deliverables: what must exist before what can be verified.

## Ordering rule

Never block verification of artifact B on speculative polish for unrelated artifact A unless A is truly prerequisite.

## Checkpointing

After each coherent chunk, confirm intermediate artifacts exist and match intent before widening scope.

## Backtrack discipline

If downstream verification fails, trace prerequisites upstream rather than stacking patches at the symptom only.
